title: Chapito [16x]
description: you wished your swords had hats too, huh ?
body:
Chapito's main goal as an epic texture pack is to add little hats to sword, while it might look a little goofy that's the whole point !


It is made currently for 1.8.9 but might get updated to other versions if the packs gets some intrest.


This texture pack also features some QOL features to just enhance your overall experience with the pack like the new 1.16 textures in 1.8.9 to make the game look cleaner and smoother as well as a fully custom made Sky to make it feel fresher.


/!\ The Custom made Sky only works with optifine, if you don't use optifine, it probably won' work as expected /!\


Here are some screenshots to showcase more of the pack :)


![chapito 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ebdf62dde779debcc79fe4779419e10a376f89d.jpeg)

![chapito 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff44f22d3454f8bd08f64d5c3822eaafd9be2f39.jpeg)

![chapito 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9630f4d85731845a5ee7c3143f652eae9520f23.jpeg)

Sidenote : Feel free to join the discord if there is any issues with the Texture pack (Rendering Issues, Crashes, Textures not working properly, Sky glitches and/or not rendering...) It helps us greatly improve the work we do and provide the best for you all !
